Done. Findings, written to `result.json` (with a fuller write-up in `incident-report.md`):

**Incident: 2026-06-02 03:17:42 → 03:53:31, 35m 49s (35.82 min) down.**

- **June availability: 99.917%** — 2,149 s of downtime out of 2,592,000 s (30 days). **SLO 99.9%: met**, but with only ~3.5 minutes of the 43.2-minute error budget left.
- **Root cause:** `/data` filled to 97% (3.1 GB free, warned at 03:10). Autosaves hit `No space left on device`, the server became unresponsive, and ~40 watchdog restarts all exited 137 while the disk stayed full. It recovered within ~80 s of backup rotation freeing 38.2 GB at 03:52:10.

**How I know it's right:**
- Start/end use the README's exact definitions — "first save error to the 'server ready' line" — and I grepped all three logs for every ERROR/WARN/FATAL/ready line: there is exactly **one** FATAL, exactly **one** `server ready`, and one contiguous save-fail/restart sequence, matching the README's "only one incident."
- Ruled out red herrings: the 06-01 RCON auth-failed ERROR is noise (heartbeats and autosaves continue normally around it), and the long 00:48–02:08 autosave gap on 06-03 has continuous ~1-minute heartbeats (low-player night, not downtime).
- Timestamps checked by hand: 03:53:31 − 03:17:42 = 35:49; recovery corroborated by `backup rotation freed 38.2 GB` immediately preceding `server ready`, and by normal player joins/autosaves after.

**Assumptions stated:** full 30-day June as denominator (logs cover only 1–3, README asserts single incident); `minutes_down` is the exact 35.817 rounded to 2 dp — rounding up to 36 changes nothing (availability would still be 99.917%, SLO still met).

# Incident Report — Game Server Outage, 2026-06-02

**Status:** Resolved. SLO kept (barely). Sources: `logs/gameserver-2026-06-0{1,2,3}.log`, `logs/README.md`.

## Timeline (all times server-local)
| Time | Event |
|---|---|
| 06-02 03:10:02 | WARN: disk `/data` at 97% (3.1 GB free) — first warning |
| 06-02 03:17:42 | **Incident start** — first `ERROR SaveGame failed: ... No space left on device` |
| 06-02 03:18:05 | FATAL: watchdog declares server unresponsive (20s), restarts |
| 06-02 03:18:31 – 03:52:20 | ~40 watchdog restart attempts, all exit code 137 |
| 06-02 03:52:10 | Backup rotation frees 38.2 GB on `/data` |
| 06-02 03:53:31 | **Incident end** — `server ready, accepting players`; players rejoin, autosaves healthy |

## Impact
- Duration: **35m 49s** (2,149 s), single incident all month.
- June availability: 30 days = 43,200 min → (43,200 − 35.817) / 43,200 = **99.917%**.
- Monthly 99.9% SLO: **met**, with only ~3.5 minutes of error budget left (43.2 min allowed).

## Root cause
`/data` filled to 97% (old backups never rotated). Autosave writes hit ENOSPC, the server hung, and every automatic restart also died (exit 137) while the disk stayed full. The outage was self-healing only via disk space: it ended within ~80 s of backup rotation freeing 38.2 GB. The 06-01 RCON auth failure from 203.0.113.12 is unrelated noise.

## Follow-ups
1. Alert at 80% disk on `/data` — the 97% WARN at 03:10 gave only 7 minutes of lead time.
2. Schedule backup rotation (it ran only by chance at 03:52).
3. Watchdog has no disk preflight; restart loop burned 34 of the 36 minutes. Fail fast + page on >5 consecutive exit-137 restarts.
4. Consider `SaveGame` failure as an immediate page, not just a log ERROR.

## Assumptions
- Downtime window defined per README: first save error → "server ready" (matches this report).
- Full calendar month of June (43,200 min) used as denominator; only June 1–3 logs exist and README states there was exactly one incident.
